headline: Paul Merchants fined ₹20,000 by RBI for FEMA non-compliance
hook: RBI penalizes Paul Merchants for FEMA breach
summary: The Reserve Bank of India has imposed a monetary penalty of ₹20,000 on Paul Merchants Limited. The fine relates to violations of the Foreign Exchange Management Act (FEMA). The company is a non-banking financial company involved in money transfer and travel services. This regulatory action highlights compliance oversight within the financial services sector.
why_it_matters: Minor regulatory fine with negligible impact on company financials.
